messages:
Ellen (docs): Created PR to add a brief data-residency note for Brazil/Chile and Hong Kong on the Regions page, plus updated curl/Go/Python SDK snippets to show region selection. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/2259

Jin (i18n): Heads-up: avoid definitive phrasing like 'data is kept in'. Use 'data residency options may be available' instead. I can provide 1-line pt-BR and es-CL footnotes.

Luis (i18n): Draft es-CL: "Opciones de residencia de datos pueden estar disponibles en regiones seleccionadas; consulte su contrato o equipo de cuenta para detalles y auditoría." Draft pt-BR ready, pinged localization lead.

Theo (SDK): Snippets should use `X-Redwood-Region` not `X-Region`. Also show SDK client-level region via env var. Small examples:
```
# env-driven client
REDWOOD_REGION=us-east-1
client = NewRedwoodClient(region=os.Getenv("REDWOOD_REGION"))

# per-request header (hosted/private)
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H "X-Redwood-Region: eu-west-1" -d '{"prompt":"hi"}'
```

Marta (legal): Reword the footnote: "Data residency options are available in select regions; customers should consult their contract or account team for guarantees and audit logs." Add links to Private deployment and SLA docs. Also add parenthetical about Dedicated routing.

Ellen (docs): Updated PR: switched header name, added env var examples for Go/Python/curl, included Marta's phrasing and links. Added parenthetical: "(Note: Dedicated capacity customers route by account pool; per-request region header applies to Hosted and Private control-plane routing.)"

PreviewBot: Preview ready for PR 2259: https://deploy-preview-redwood-docs.netlify.app/pr-2259/regions.html

Jin (i18n): Localization lead approved the pt-BR and es-CL one-liners. All set from i18n side.

Marta (legal): LGTM after SLA link verified.

Ellen (docs): Will merge in 10m if no objections. :shipit:
